contentText: PRESS REVIEW – Thursday, November 26: French media outlets Mediapart and Le Monde publish an additional trove of messages purporting to show far-right leader Jordan Bardella's rampant anti-Semitic thoughts as a young member of the party in 2013. Also: France holds the first trial of a female jihadist, Émilie König. Kilmar Abrego Garcia, once the face of Donald Trump's brutal mass deportations, arrives in Spain. Plus: we find out why the rich world is in the midst of a "sex recession."
